text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I head to the track for training only to find a large group of people already there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Curious, I make my way through the crowd, only to find…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Behold! Just by having this mystical stone in your possession, your luck will increase!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: This here is a wooden bear carving that improves disposition with a single touch! And this is a noh mask that grants you the power of flight!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I'm here to share my blessings with you all, a parcel of fortune from me to you! Please, give them a try!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanefukukitaru is talking up a big show and hawking her lucky wares to all the Umamusume passing by.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Why, hello there, Trainer! Feel free to try one out yourself!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I start with the mask… but nothing happens.
choice_data_list: My feet are still on the ground.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Well then! Don't you worry, there is still plenty of good fortune to go around!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I mean, I just can't keep myself from winning! Left or right, here or there, all I find is fortune at every turn!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Doesn't that make me the luckiest Umamusume around? Surely, it does!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's won the Kyoto Shimbun Hai, Kobe Shimbun Hai, and Kikuka Sho, among others. Luck certainly has been on her side. However…
choice_data_list: (I think she's getting way too carried away…)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's been acting strange ever since the Kikuka Sho. Her attitude is worrisome, to say the least.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: No sooner do I have that thought, when…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: How do you do, Matikanefukukitaru?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I'm pleased to find you in good spirits. A beautiful autumn day, is it not?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It's good to see you too, Bright! What auspicious timing!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: We see each other quite often, but I've been feeling a particularly special connection between us lately.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Maybe it's because we've been competing in so many of the same races! I have just the thing for you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh my, is that so? Which of these goods are you referring to?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: This! Behold, the Great God of Fish Cakes!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! It's exactly what it sounds like—a figure of a god carved out of a board for serving fish cakes!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It represents a fleet-footed deity. Carry it around, and you might carve a few seconds off your best time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Goodness! What a wonderful gift. I'm ever so grateful.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright takes the slightly misshapen Great God of Fish Cakes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'll be sure to carry it with me every day to reap its benefits.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Yes, please do! I'm sure you'll find it to be stupendously effective!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: If not, I fear I'll never be capable of winning against you, Matikanefukukitaru.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: …Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I may have suffered defeat at your hands on a number of occasions, but that is all in the past now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I am of the firm belief that true victory comes only after a series of bitter defeats.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Soon enough, victory will come within my reach—a truly brilliant victory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh… Would you look at the time? I must be off to my training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Until we meet again, on the day I emerge victorious.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Beneath her serene smile, Mejiro Bright simmers with fierce determination. As for Matikanefukukitaru…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I can't believe it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: She will emerge victorious? Against the luckiest Umamusume on the planet?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: That's quite the declaration! But she forgets I am protected by the gods! For I possess… the Fish Cake God of War!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright's provocation is lost on Matikanefukukitaru, who's off in her own universe. If anything, it only makes her more confident.
